value.name: visit house for lunch
value.description: Daniel says he went to the house the following Saturday and ate lunch with her without mentioning the codicil.
evidence: "I went to the house the following Saturday. I sat at this table and ate lunch with her and I did not say anything about the codicil and neither did she."

value.name: woman falls ill and dies
value.description: After the lunch visit, she becomes sick again, worsens, and dies a week later.
evidence: "And then she got sick again a week later, and then she got sicker, and then she died."

value.name: Daniel takes folder after death
value.description: The morning after her death, Daniel goes to the sewing room and takes the folder while Rosa is making coffee.
evidence: "And the morning after she died I went up to the sewing room while Rosa was making coffee and I took the folder."

value.name: Daniel admits motive to preserve old will
value.description: Daniel explains that he took the folder because he hoped the 2020 will would remain in force and the codicil could be undone.
evidence: "Because I thought —" He stopped. He looked at the table. "I thought if no one found it, the will from 2020 would stand. I thought I could — I thought I could undo it."

value.name: Rosa rebukes Daniel
value.description: Rosa addresses Daniel by name in a restrained rebuke, and he responds with remorse and a plea.

value.name: brief hand contact
value.description: Rosa and Daniel briefly touch hands across the table before he withdraws.
evidence: "She did not say anything else. She put her hand back on the table, and after a moment he reached out and covered it with his, briefly, and then he took his hand back."

value.name: Asha orders codicil photographed
value.description: Asha instructs Marcus to photograph the codicil and filing receipt, then secure them in the folder and keep the box in her custody.
evidence: "Photograph the codicil and the receipt of filing. Then we'll put them back in the folder and the folder goes into the box and the box does not leave my custody."

value.name: Asha demands signed statement
value.description: Asha tells Daniel she will draft a short statement for him to sign acknowledging what he has said.
evidence: "Mr. Serrano, I'm going to need you to sign a short statement this afternoon — I'll draft it — acknowledging on the record what you've just told me. Are you willing to do that."

value.name: Daniel agrees to sign statement
value.description: Daniel agrees to sign the statement Asha requests.

value.name: Asha explains legal consequences
value.description: Asha says she will confirm the codicil filing, notify probate court, and stop the sale unless all three heirs agree.
evidence: "Now I call Mr. Halloran. I confirm the filing of the codicil with his office. I notify the probate court of the existence of the amendment. The sale you have in motion does not go forward without the agreement of all three heirs"
